==Acquisition==
*Talk to [[Lexx]] [Asuran Talent Scout] in [[Rata Sum]] after attaining the first rank of the [[Asura rank|Asura title track]].

== Notes ==
* This cannot be equipped on the [[skill bar]]. While a [[character]] displays the Asura title, this effect is applied to that character and all of their [[hero]]es.
* ''Asura territory'' includes all towns, outposts, and explorable areas in the [[Tarnished Coast]], as well as [[Gadd's Encampment]] and [[Sparkfly Swamp]].
** Edification also provides extra energy during all [[Finding the Bloodstone]] and [[The Elusive Golemancer]] instances.
* Hero energy remains the same in outposts whether the title is switched on or off.
